name: opcua-kb-mcp
description: OPC UA Knowledge Base MCP Server — 17 tools: structured NodeSet search, RAG Q&A, validate/compliance/compare NodeSets, modelling guidance, the OPC UA Profile graph + conformance tools, and asynchronous live-server → companion-spec projection, across all OPC UA specifications and companion specs.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search OPC UA NodeSet nodes with structured filters (node class, spec, parent type, modelling rule). Version-aware.

tools.name: get_type_hierarchy
tools.description: Get ObjectType inheritance chain with declared/inherited member counts.

tools.name: get_spec_summary
tools.description: Get pre-computed NodeSet statistics for a companion spec or all specs.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across OPC UA specification HTML pages and tables. Version-aware.

tools.name: search_docs_rag
tools.description: RAG Q&A grounded by the OPC UA spec corpus (KB retrieve + GPT-4o).

tools.name: count_nodes
tools.description: Faceted aggregation by node_class, spec_part, modelling_rule, or data_type.

tools.name: list_specs
tools.description: Ranked catalog of all indexed companion specs and CloudLib NodeSets.

tools.name: validate_nodeset
tools.description: Validate NodeSet XML (inline ≤30KB, blob: ref, or https URL) against OPC UA + OPC 11030 best practices.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Compare two spec versions, classify changes as backward-compatible or breaking.

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Check a NodeSet implementation (inline, blob: ref, or https URL) against a companion spec.

tools.name: suggest_model
tools.description: Suggest OPC UA information model design based on a domain description.

tools.name: list_profile_groups
tools.description: List OPC UA Profile groups (spec + version, e.g. UACore 1.05) with profile/conformance-unit counts and release-status mix.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get a profile's graph neighborhood: status, required/optional conformance units, included profiles, and reverse 'included by' edges.

tools.name: query_profiles
tools.description: Filter profiles by name fragment, group, and release status, then expand includes / included_by relationships.

tools.name: check_profile_conformance
tools.description: Traverse the conformance graph in expand / satisfy / diff modes over transitive required/optional conformance units.

tools.name: create_companion_projection
tools.description: Submit a live-server NodeSet2 (inline / blob: ref / allow-listed URL) to a durable async job that projects it onto official companion specs; returns a job ID.

tools.name: get_companion_projection
tools.description: Poll a companion projection job and retrieve the generated NodeSet2, node-to-node mapping JSON/CSV, reports, and ZIP bundle.

api-key.description: Application api-key. Optional for tool calls when the server allows anonymous access (MCP_REQUIRE_AUTH=false); required for POST /upload-nodeset and GET /mapping-artifacts.
